omissions: Transversal S is an assumed cost model, not a verified surface logical gate realization.
Additional SE syndromes are unobserved cost receipts; noisy decoding and logical correction are omitted.
Waiting-period SE maintenance is omitted; elapsed waiting remains part of cost.
Generic preparation correction is a one-Pauli-layer resource envelope.
External output transport, consumption and reset costs are excluded; next-cycle preparation is counted.
Input p and ideal-Clifford 15-to-1 acceptance are reference assumptions, not decoded physical output quality.
Dynamic occupied-area-time and unavailable atom exposure must remain unknown in a summary-only model.
Raw supply acceptance is held at its archived per-distance/role reference; new geometry noise is reported as exposure, not re-simulated detector rejection.
AOD atomic capture closure, microscopic docking, spectator illumination and trajectory collision checks are not performed by the block-center model.
